title.narrative: Media and Information Literacy for All

description.narrative: UNESCO will continue to promote Media and Information Literacy (MIL) and digital competencies for all to empower citizens of all ages to adopt a critical mindset when engaging with information, digital technologies, and media. Support to Member States to develop and implement MIL policies and support its integration in formal, non-formal and informal education at all levels will be strengthened with an increased focused on digital transformation. This will be done through leading Global MIL Week celebrations and rolling-out existing UNESCO resources as well as new tools reflecting current challenges such as Hate speech and Disinformation or Generative Artificial Intelligence. UNESCO will scale up its support to youth organizations to build their capacities on MIL. Furthermore, actions will be implemented to strengthen and systemize the integration of media and information literacy in media organizations including regularities bodies.
